description: Rijnbuurt-Oost (Plan Zuid, BAG 1934), Boterdiepstraat 9-33 (odd side): a 6.1 m brick front, every house alike (not mirrored): the house door with a side light at the left party wall under a white slab canopy, a narrow window axis over it, a two-storey canted brick erker on the right axis (white-framed three-light glazing over brick stallrisers on storeys 1-2) standing on a white console over a wide ground window, and the top storey three two-light windows 0.38 m apart over both axes, their white frames reading as one band, under a shallow flat-roof overhang with a white fascia

overhang.note: a shallower overhang than the even side's

door-left.note: the house door and side light under a white slab at the left party wall

match.note: an erker on every house on the same side; the top-storey ribbon tells it from the erker-pair type, which the photo decides (auto-place --photo-decides)

rhythm.bays: a narrow window axis and a wide erker axis; the top storey one ribbon
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: door + 1 wide | 1-2: 1 + erker | 3: three two-light windows in a band
rhythm.symmetry: repeated, not mirrored: every erker on the right
rhythm.groundFloor: the house door at the left party wall, a wide window under the erker console
rhythm.roofline: flat roof with a shallow white-fascia overhang

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2020-01-07 re-rectified with the camera 2.1 m over the ground (intake --camera-height=2.1), ruler crop of 17-19 at 64 px/m: door 0.4-1.9 m with a side light to 2.35 m, slab canopy at 2.85 m; narrow window 1.1-2.35 m, sills 4.0 / 7.0 m, heads 5.85 / 8.9 m; erker 2.9-5.8 m on storeys 1-2, its console over the ground window (1.0-2.8 m); ribbon 1.1-5.55 m x 10.2-11.6 m; fascia top rectified at 13.0 m over 3DBAG eaves 12.3 m (a ~0.45 m overhang at 6.5 m)

schemaLimits: the ground storey's canted bay under the erker is drawn as a flat window under the erker console (bayWindows.storeys start at 1)

the top band varies along the row (Boterdiepstraat 19: four lights frame to frame; 21: six narrow lights); the type draws the common three two-light windows with brick piers (storeyRibbons pier 0.38), not the white posts between them
the door's side light is part of the door opening
